wet's annual flow on FWA segments, with a parent fallback

Source: R/link_flow.R
knw_link_flow.Rd

scripts/0294's flow read, for any set of FWA segments. The flow is month 0 (the annual mean) of discharge.fwa_v1_segment_monthly, scenario historical, as wet::wet_db_load() loaded it: pick marks wet's default source per segment, and both sources' values come back beside it. A segment with no picked flow, or with no watershed code (side channels and connectors with no watershed lut row), is not dropped: it takes the picked flow of the nearest primary-flow segment on its main line (watershed_key) or its own line, and flow_from says which (own, parent, or NA for neither); such a segment takes that segment's watershed codes too (code_from_parent).

Usage

knw_link_flow(conn, linear_feature_id)

Arguments

conn

a DBI connection to a database holding discharge and whse_basemapping.

linear_feature_id

numeric FWA segment ids.

Value

A tibble, one row per segment: linear_feature_id, side_channel, fwa_gradient, wscode, localcode, code_from_parent, waterbody_key, mad_pick, pick_source, mad_routed, mad_balance, flow_from, parent_dist_m.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres())
knw_link_flow(conn, c(701747495, 701747496))
} # }
